Annulment stands at 9% (8, 10, 14, 12, 30; mean 13.5%, calibrated 9%). Annulments are rare (Moldava among 97 decided by 4 November); a public hearing with witnesses points to a real factual dispute, but the winners took 69% and five of seven seats and the urn seals were said to be intact. cs.headline: Soud v Olomouci po výslechu svědků potvrdil platnost voleb v Želechovicích
body: Krajský soud v Ostravě – pobočka v Olomouci v pondělí rozhodl o pěti spojených stížnostech na říjnové komunální volby v Želechovicích na Olomoucku a hlasování za neplatné neprohlásil. Soud kvůli předvolaným svědkům nařídil od 9:00 veřejné zasedání, což je u volebních stížností výjimečné.

Stěžovatelé tvrdili, že někdo v noci mezi oběma volebními dny narušil uzamčení a úřední pečeť volební místnosti. Starosta Antonín Hampl, jehož uskupení získalo téměř 69 procent hlasů a pět ze sedmi mandátů, vniknutí odmítl a uvedl, že čtyři podepsané pečetě na volební urně byly neporušené; policie podezření z protiprávního jednání nezjistila. Obec do rozhodnutí soudu nemohla svolat ustavující zastupitelstvo.
Ke 4. listopadu dostaly krajské soudy 230 stížností na komunální volby a rozhodly 97 z nich, většinu zamítly; na Moldavě na Teplicku soud volby prohlásil za neplatné.
cs.basis: Vychází z dvacetidenní lhůty pro volební stížnosti, která zhruba v tento den uplynula, z neporušených pečetí na urně a z toho, že policie nezjistila trestný čin; hlavním rizikem bylo odložení rozhodnutí na pozdější den.
analysis: Rozhodnutí vyhlášené 9. listopadu: 82 % (základní míra 70, důkazy 80, oponent 62, kotva 72, nezávislý 80; průměr 73,3 %, po kalibraci 82 %). Soudy mají 20 dní od doručení, což při podání stížností v polovině října končí kolem 9. listopadu, a rozhodnutí obvykle vyhlašují na konci veřejného zasedání; třída odkladů cz-court-ruling dává 0,12.

Zneplatnění voleb: 9 % (8, 10, 14, 12, 30; průměr 13,5 %, po kalibraci 9 %). Zneplatnění jsou vzácná (Moldava mezi 97 rozhodnutými ke 4. listopadu); veřejné zasedání se svědky ukazuje na skutečný spor o fakta, vítězové však získali 69 procent a pět ze sedmi mandátů a pečetě na urně byly podle starosty neporušené. Sázkový trh neexistuje.

claims.label: Court rules on Želechovice vote
claims.text: On 9 November 2026 the Regional Court in Ostrava, Olomouc branch, announces its decision on the five complaints about the municipal election in Želechovice (Olomouc region).
claims.criterion: YES if on 9 Nov 2026 (by 23:59 Prague time) the court announces or issues a decision on the merits of the joined complaints about the October 2026 municipal election in Želechovice (Olomouc district), whatever its content, as reported by ČTK, Czech regional media or the court's spokesman, or shown on the court's website. NO if the hearing is adjourned, the decision is announced later, or the hearing does not take place on 9 Nov.

research.question: When were the five Želechovice (Olomoucko) complaints filed, i.e. when does the court's 20-day limit run out?
research.finding: Exact filing dates not found; the court website and Hanácká Drbna could not be read (404 / TLS error). Indirect dating: Olomoucký deník already reported on 15 Oct 07:00Z that 'Volby ve vsi na Olomoucku prověří soud', so at least one complaint was filed by about 14-15 Oct. ČT Ostrava headline 14 Oct: 'Začíná lhůta pro stížnosti na volby - 14. října', so the 10-day filing window ran from about 14 Oct to about 23-24 Oct. The 20-day limit from receipt therefore ran out for the earliest complaints about 3-4 Nov, and for any filed last about 12-13 Nov. Courts treat this limit as instructional, not binding (own knowledge, not sourced). The court joined all five complaints and set a public hearing on Mon 9 Nov at 09:00 with summoned witnesses (Aktuálně/ČTK, 6 Nov 09:52 CET). Since the earliest limits have already run out, pressure to announce on the day is high, but nothing found says the ruling will be announced at the hearing.

claims.label: Court annuls Želechovice vote
claims.text: On 9 November 2026 the Regional Court in Ostrava, Olomouc branch, declares the municipal election, or the vote, in Želechovice (Olomouc region) invalid.
claims.criterion: YES if on 9 Nov 2026 (by 23:59 Prague time) the court announces or issues a decision declaring the October 2026 municipal election or the vote in Želechovice (Olomouc district) invalid (neplatnost voleb / neplatnost hlasování), as reported by ČTK, Czech regional media or the court's spokesman, or shown on the court's website. NO if the court rejects or dismisses the complaints, declares only an individual candidate's election invalid, changes the result without annulment, adjourns, or announces its decision after 9 Nov.
claims.publishes: ČTK and regional media on Monday 9 Nov; court spokesman Igor Krajdl

baseline.why: YES needs the court to overturn a declared result; most complaints are rejected.
baseline.set_by: dossier agent, before the forecasters reported

checked: markets.mjs search Czech municipal election court

agents.reason_blind: Needs the decision on 9 Nov (about 0.7, as cz-zelechovice-ruling-10) and annulment. P(void | decided) about 0.12.

agents.reason_blind: Case for YES: courts rarely hold public witness hearings on election complaints, so this one evidently could not dismiss the overnight breach of the sealed polling room on the papers; five separate complaints suggest several witnesses, ballots kept overnight in a breached room are a defect whose effect cannot be excluded, and in a 250-voter village a handful of ballots moves a seat on a seven-member council. Case for NO: the winner took almost 69% and 5 of 7 seats, police found no suspicion of an offence, the mayor says the urn's four seals were intact, Czech courts annul only for defects that could plausibly have changed the result (most of the 97 decided complaints were rejected), and the claim also needs the decision on Monday itself. p_held 0.62 (decision announced 9 Nov, as in the ruling claim), p_if_held 0.22 that it is an annulment.

Blind estimate stands: annulment needs a result-affecting defect against a 69 percent, 5-of-7 win with police finding nothing; the witness hearing is the only YES signal.

No market (signals). p_held here is the chance of a same-day ruling (0.72, from cz-zelechovice-ruling-10). Annulment base rate among decided municipal complaints is a few percent (Moldava one of 97 decided by 4 Nov, most rejected); raised to about 0.17 because the court called a rare public hearing with witnesses, so the allegation is taken seriously and a breach of the sealed room overnight in a village of ~250 voters could plausibly affect the 5-of-7 seat split. Held low because police found no suspicion of an offence, the mayor says the four urn seals were intact, and the winning list had almost 69%.

research.question: Is there evidence of actual tampering in Želechovice beyond an alleged breach of the polling-room lock/seal?
research.finding: None found. The only allegation reported is that someone breached the lock and official seal of the polling room in the night of 9-10 Oct. Police (spokesman Herzán) found no suspicion of any unlawful act so far. Mayor Hampl says the ballot box had four seals signed by the commission, which were intact and passed inspection. No report of mismatched ballot counts, missing or extra ballots, or a witness seeing entry; the hearing exists because the evidence is mainly witness testimony. The winning list had about 69% and 5 of 7 seats. The 16 Oct Hanácká Drbna piece ('Byl někdo v noci ve volební místnosti?') could not be read (TLS error). Absence of tampering evidence points to rejection, but the witnesses' testimony on Monday is unknown.
